youtube.title: A 16:9 screen recording in, a 9:16 Short out: speed ramp, push-in, pixels as recorded
youtube.description:
16:9 screen recording in, 9:16 Short out.
A speed ramp on the scroll and a push-in on the Quickstart. Framing only crops and scales; it never changes what the recording shows.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.

16:9 screen recording in, 9:16 Short out.

A 1x to 3x speed ramp on the scroll, a push-in (one line in the shot list), and framing that only crops and scales. Rendered in under 50 s on a 4-core CPU, no GPU.
